problems.title: Signature extraction calls nameof on a quoted callable value
problems.summary: A macro can embed a callable struct as a literal callee. The method can be evaluated in Julia, but signature extraction throws a MethodError when it tries to name the struct instance.

draft.title: Signature extraction calls nameof on a quoted callable value
draft.body:
A macro can embed a callable struct as a literal callee. The method can be evaluated in Julia, but signature extraction throws a MethodError when it tries to name the struct instance.

```julia
using LoweredCodeUtils
struct Offset
    n::Int
end
(o::Offset)(x) = x + o.n
q = QuoteNode(Offset(2))
LoweredCodeUtils.normalize_defsig(q, Main) === q  # expected true
```

A quoted instance is a value and has no function name. The fix preserves it as a QuoteNode while retaining symbol and named function, type and module handling. The regression also walks a complete macro-style method definition and executes it.

commits.title: Leave a quoted callee that has no name alone in normalize_defsig

fix.why_together: One commit changes callee normalization and tests both the quoted value and the complete method-definition walk.

validation.detail: 99 of 99 assertions passed on the dogfood commit, including quoted callable normalization and method-definition traversal.
